draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Thanjavur! You're standing right by the Big Temple, Rajarajesvaram, which the Chola emperor Rajaraja I built between 1003 and 1010 CE. Its Nandi is one of the largest bull statues in India, carved out of a single granite rock.
draft.hungryLine: Head to the Old bus stand, just behind the temple, for banana leaf thalis, crisp dosas and ghee murukku.

moodReplies.show-me-around: Start with the Brihadisvara Temple, a minute's walk away, then stroll 5 minutes to the Rev. Schwartz Memorial Church. The palace with the Saraswathi Mahal Library is in town too.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Siva Ganga Garden sits between the Big Temple and the Schwartz Church, with a little train, a temple in the middle of the pond and boating on the water.
moodReplies.surprise-me: The Saraswathi Mahal Library holds well over 49,000 volumes, and Encyclopedia Britannica called it the most remarkable library of India.

spots.detail: 1 min walk · Rajaraja I's UNESCO listed Shiva temple with its giant stone Nandi

spots.name: Saraswathi Mahal Library
spots.detail: In town · Palm leaf manuscripts in Tamil and Sanskrit inside the Saraboji Palace

legends.title: The Big Temple
legends.body: Locals just call it Thanjai Periya Kovil, the Thanjavur Big Temple, or Peruvudaiyar Kovil, the temple of the great lord. It's also known as Dakshina Meru, the Meru of the South.

legends.title: Blessed by elephants
legends.body: Near the sanctum, with its huge Shiva lingam and stone Nandi, two live elephants bless the pilgrims. It's one of the sweetest moments of a visit.

tips.title: Walk in for free.
tips.body: Entry to the Brihadisvara Temple complex is free, so give yourself time for the cloisters, shrines and the little garden at the back.

tips.title: Catch the Sunday service early.
tips.body: The Schwartz Church holds its English service every Sunday at 7:00 in the morning.

story.title: Rajaraja's temple
story.body: Chola emperor Rajaraja I built Rajarajesvaram on the south bank of the Cauvery, ringed by a moat. It became one of the largest Hindu temples and a model of Tamil architecture.

story.title: Sister temples
story.body: Later Chola kings built two more great temples nearby, at Gangaikonda Cholapuram and Darasuram. Together with Thanjavur's they make up the Great Living Chola Temples.

story.title: A library begins
story.body: The Nayak kings of Thanjavur started the Saraswathi Mahal Library, one of the oldest surviving libraries in Asia. It now holds rare palm leaf and paper manuscripts in Tamil, Sanskrit and other languages.

story.title: Schwartz's church
story.body: Rev. Schwartz built a church next to the temple garden. It still runs today under the CSI Trichy-Tanjore Diocese.

story.title: World Heritage
story.body: UNESCO listed the Big Temple as a World Heritage Site in 1987, and added its two sister temples in 2004.
